justification: The package contains only 2 top-level classes (JavaSymbolSolver and SourceFileInfoExtractor) plus one small nested utility class (ArrayLengthValueDeclaration), totaling roughly 700 lines of code. This is not excessive either in number of classes or in overall LOC. Responsibilities are also reasonably separated: JavaSymbolSolver acts as a facade implementing the SymbolResolver interface and delegating most work to JavaParserFacade/JavaParserFactory, while SourceFileInfoExtractor handles file traversal and reporting. Although JavaSymbolSolver's resolveDeclaration method is long due to a chain of instanceof branches, a single long method is a method-level concern and does not make the package-level component excessively large. Therefore the God Component smell is not detected.

Neither the class count nor the LOC approaches thresholds typically considered excessive for a God Component.

The package contains an excessive number of classes (27 classes) implementing the Context pattern, which itself suggests a God Component. More critically, several individual classes exhibit severe God Object characteristics. MethodCallExprContext is excessively large (exceeding 500 lines) and centralizes overwhelming responsibility for complex type inference, method resolution logic, generic type parameter resolution, lambda constraint handling, and variadic parameter processing. It acts as a central hub with high coupling to numerous type system classes (MethodUsage, ResolvedType, InferenceContext, LeastUpperBoundLogic). CompilationUnitContext also displays God Object tendencies, handling diverse responsibilities including static import resolution, package resolution, composite name parsing, and method/field resolution with a ThreadLocal cache mechanism. StatementContext is similarly large and manages complex symbol resolution across block scopes, pattern variables, and statement iteration. The concentration of complex resolution logic in these few classes, combined with the high class count, indicates the package suffers from the God Component smell.
